features.name: Open reports in expanded mode
features.description: AL developers can open Power BI reports in expanded mode directly using an AL action, allowing users to view reports with full screen real estate.

features.name: Prevent report change in context
features.description: Developers can prevent users from changing which report is shown in a specific Business Central context by locking the selected element.
caveats: Prevents user experimentation and navigation to different reports

features.name: Control report page selection
features.description: Developers can enable or prevent users from changing the report page when viewing multi-page reports through flag configuration.

features.name: Power BI Scorecards embedding
features.description: Developers can now embed Power BI scorecards in Business Central, treating them like any other Power BI report or dashboard. Scorecards require a scorecard key and invite URL to display.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are taking advantage of the new powerbi scorecards which were uh released in the last few months and now you can also embed
caveats: Scorecards were recently released by Power BI

features.name: No-code scorecard setup for end users
features.description: End users can set up Power BI scorecards to track business KPIs without coding, pointing to KPIs defined in Power BI.
caveats: Requires KPIs to be pre-defined in Power BI
Metrics can come from Business Central or external systems

features.name: Power BI display element record type
features.description: Developers use the PowerBI Display Element record type to configure which report to embed, setting element type, report ID, and embed URL from Power BI REST APIs.
caveats: Requires Power BI REST API information

features.name: Report visual embedding
features.description: Developers can embed individual Power BI report visuals instead of entire reports, focusing on specific charts or visualizations. Developers can specify page ID and visual ID to display specific chart elements from a report.
caveats: Requires page ID and visual ID from Power BI report

features.name: Multi-page report support
features.description: Developers can direct reports to specific report pages in multi-page reports and enable or disable page navigation for users.

features.name: Visual Hierarchy Navigation
features.description: Developers can traverse Power BI visual hierarchy including reports, pages, and individual visuals. Full flexibility available to point to specific visuals within a report structure.
features.status_evidence_quote: full flexibility into that hierarchy of visuals now available for for developers

features.name: Query Analysis UI
features.description: New analysis toggle button and UI added to query objects for data analysis. Queries can be embedded as actions on pages without users knowing they are queries, providing slice and dice data exploration capabilities.
caveats: previously queries were mainly used for performance tuning

features.name: Query Data Analysis with Pivot and Grouping
features.description: Queries now support complete data analysis slice and dice experience including renaming, additional analysis tabs, grouping, and pivoting. Users can work with data from multiple joined tables with friendly display names.

features.name: Excel Layout Multiple Data Sheets
features.description: New property for report objects enabling multiple worksheets in Excel layouts. Each data item gets its own worksheet, simplifying Power Query integration and enabling Power Pivot relationships without complex null areas.
caveats: previous Excel layouts did not handle parent child or overview detailed data types well

features.name: Power Pivot Relationships in Excel
features.description: Power Pivot can now model relationships between multiple data items from report objects when using multiple data sheets in Excel layouts. Enables creation of powerful interactive reports with related data.

features.name: Teaching Tips on Queries and Reports
features.description: Teaching tips now available on query objects and report request pages. Uses same AL code pattern as pages with about title, about text, and context-sensitive help page properties.
features.status_evidence_quote: teaching tips is now available on queries and on reports

features.name: Context-sensitive help for reports and queries
features.description: Context-sensitive help now available on query objects and report request pages with teaching tips. Help will appear in help pane and Help Me feature when properly configured. Uses AboutTitle, AboutText, and ContextSensitiveHelpPage properties.

features.name: Usage Category for Queries
features.description: New usage category block on queries. Setting it to Reports and Analysis will display queries in Tell Me help and Report Explorer in version 23.1 and later.

features.name: BC Tech Repo code samples
features.description: Code samples and documentation for Power BI integration with AL developers available on the BC Tech Repository at aka.ms/bc including parameter handling guidance.

features.name: Power BI learning paths
features.description: Free learning paths available on docs for AL developers to learn Power BI integration and get started with the Power BI tool.

features.name: Report layout resilience guidance
features.description: Updated documentation including ways to make report layouts resilient to failures for both Excel and Power BI reporting experiences.

features.name: Excel samples and guidance
features.description: Guidance on defining data sets and layouts with various Excel techniques including table formulas, dynamic arrays, and Power Query at aka.ms/bc-excel-samples.

features.name: Power BI community resources
features.description: Community-contributed resources including videos, PowerPoint decks, FAQ, and code samples for learning and presenting Power BI with Business Central.

features.name: Analytical requirements assessment approach
features.description: Guidance for developers to shift from blindly building reports to understanding and supporting customer analytical requirements before choosing technology.

features.name: Power BI for Business Central analytics
features.description: Power BI positioned as the Microsoft tool of choice for business intelligence and analysis of Business Central data, enabling ad hoc analysis and self-service capabilities.

features.name: Queries as powerful analytical tool
features.description: Queries positioned as powerful tools beyond performance analysis, enabling data mashup, ad hoc analysis, and self-service capabilities for end users.

features.name: Excel data set approach
features.description: Excel data sets positioned as alternative reporting approach where developers provide the data set and Excel-proficient users handle layout design.
